## What's Changed
* Support spec-level Swagger URLs in Specmatic config by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2624
* chore(deps): update jackson monorepo to v2.22.1 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2623
* Resolve default Swagger URL fallback from spec base URLs by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2626
* fix: fix spec files path resolution and serialization issues encountered while running the mock via mcp tool by @vedubhat in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2621
* Respect per-spec OpenAPI source fields when resolving application APIs by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2632
* chore(deps): update specmaticreporterversion to v0.3.36 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2630
* chore: bump specmatic reporter version by @Sushant092003 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2629
* Distinguish explicit and inferred application API sources by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2634
* chore(deps): update specmaticgradlepluginversion to v0.15.21 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2628
* Deduplicate application API source discovery and refine coverage logging by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2635
* Bug: Match security credentials in requests to the mock against values in examples by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2636


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.50.0...2.50.1
